description: This file implements POSIX directory functions (__wrap_opendir, __wrap_closedir, __wrap_readdir_r) with special handling for Android asset paths, including asset directory management and emulation of directory operations for Android assets.

methods.name: gen_fd
methods.description: Generates a unique file descriptor number for Android asset directories.

methods.name: handle_db_put
methods.description: Stores an AAssetDir pointer in a map with a generated file descriptor.

methods.name: handle_db_get
methods.description: Retrieves and optionally erases an AAssetDir pointer from the map using its file descriptor.
